decisions.reason: With only a 2019 dedicated listing and no clear later negative signal, an established German wholesaler would likely keep this option open because the cost of continuing to offer a standard perfect binder is relatively low while demand uncertainty is not yet fully resolved.

The fully automatic perfect binder is probably a narrower and more demanding capital-goods offer, so exit risk is somewhat higher, but under real-options logic the firm would still tend to retain it absent clear evidence of weak prospects.

Because the booklet maker extends the firm's finishing-equipment portfolio and the observed information does not yet strongly reveal failure, management would likely preserve the option and continue offering it for another year.
